## Review checklist

- [ ] This PR targets dev and references an existing issue.
- [ ] I ran the relevant local checks before pushing and recorded the results.
- [ ] I reran affected checks after further changes.
- [ ] Required CI checks pass and review discussions are resolved.
- [ ] At least one teammate other than the author approved the current changes.
